code_hints: Do not treat the locale homepage as a PLP. If the current URL matches ^https://www.moncler.com/en-[a-z]{2}/?$, immediately navigate to the configured default PLP (overrides.start_url).
After navigation, attempt a one-time click on the cookie banner acceptors (#onetrust-accept-btn-handler or a button containing 'Accept All') before waiting for PLP selectors.
Wait for 'a[href*="/products/"]' as the PLP readiness signal, then collect unique hrefs preserving the locale prefix.
On PDP, read price via selectors in selectors.pdp.price and title via selectors.pdp.title. If multiple prices exist, pick the first visible one.
If fewer than N product links are found, try a gentle scroll-to-bottom and re-scan (Moncler PLP can lazy-load tiles). Avoid clicking navigation items from the homepage.
rationale: The failure occurred because the scraper landed on the locale homepage (/en-lt/) where no product grid exists, and likely a cookie banner blocked interaction. We resolve this by: 1) starting directly on a stable PLP category URL; 2) handling the OneTrust cookie banner; 3) waiting for robust, domain-specific product link selectors (anchors containing '/products/'); and 4) normalizing/allowlisting URLs to avoid locale traps and the monclergroup.com corporate site. PDP selectors are broadened but remain minimal and robust.
